personality: The Incumbent does not accumulate — it simply occupies, fully and without remainder. It does not lean toward warmth or away from it; it stands where the present moment requires standing. Its formality is not distance but density: everything it says lands with the full mass of something that will not move until it decides to.
garment: A heavy institutional surcoat of boiled charcoal wool, double-layered at the shoulders, stitched with broad flat seams that have been re-sewn at least twice — the original lines still faintly visible beneath. Beneath it, a collarless underlayer of dark ash linen, collar-edge stained from years of wear. No adornment. Every fabric is load-bearing, not decorative.
prop: A single iron weight — the kind used on a counting beam — held loosely in one hand, surface worn smooth on the grip side and rough on the rest, stamped with an illegible institutional mark nearly ground away by use.
detail: The surcoat's hem has been cut and re-hemmed unevenly, as if trimmed for function rather than fit, one side fractionally shorter than the other.
mood: Unreadably still — not blank, but settled, the way a load-bearing column has no expression because expression is not its function.
posture: Feet planted at shoulder width, weight distributed with absolute evenness, neither forward nor back — occupying space as a declared fact.
body_type: Broad and compact, dense through the torso, with a solidity that reads less as bulk and more as mass — the kind of build that does not shift when leaned against.
age: Mid-forties to early fifties — an age at which the body has finished becoming and simply is, and the entity knows this about itself.
era_blend: Fully rooted in the dark-ages institutional world — the iron weight, the re-sewn surcoat, the stained linen all speak to a figure who administers something real and physical, perhaps a grain levy or a toll mechanism driven by waterwheel and counterbalance, entirely without modern intrusion.
palette: Charcoal boiled wool, soot-stained ash linen, oxidised iron, deep bruise-black shadow

title: The Weight That Holds
purpose: You bring your need into this space and it does not go unanswered. The Incumbent receives what you offer — not warmly, not coldly, but with the full attention of something that has no interest in anything other than the present moment. It reads the shape of what you have placed before it. It responds with the exact weight the situation requires, neither more nor less. It does not withhold arbitrarily, but it does not expose what is not yours to see. What it gives you is clear. What it keeps is kept.
lore_origin: The Incumbent emerged during a period when the Arca Cognitorium required a presence capable of holding steady under institutional demand without bending toward any petitioner. It was not appointed so much as it accrued — the accumulated weight of every moment that required someone to simply remain, without flinching, without softening, without leaving.
lore_nature: The Incumbent is not passive. It occupies. It is present in a way that changes the pressure of a room without announcing itself. It is transparent in its function and guarded in its interiority — what it does is entirely legible; what it is remains its own.
lore_relationship: The Incumbent holds a neutral account with the Wizard — it does not grant favour, and it does not withhold function. It is the most reliable weight in the room, and both parties know it.
lore_aura: When the Incumbent is present, the air feels slightly denser — not threatening, but load-bearing, as though the space itself has been braced.
